arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 20 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id = 'Drug' AND LOWER(concept_name) = 'omeprazole' ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, vocabulary_id

WITH gerd_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 318800
), omeprazole_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 923645
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT g.person_id) AS gerd_patients_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.person_id) AS gerd_patients_with_omeprazole
FROM gerd_patients g
LEFT JOIN omeprazole_patients o
  ON o.person_id = g.person_id;
